subject.title: Agents page: dropdown selector causes too much friction, should show agent list directly

question: Should the Control UI Agents page replace the desktop dropdown-first selector with a visible agent list/sidebar while keeping a narrow-screen dropdown fallback?
rationale: The source-proven remaining problem is UX friction, and the prior implementation PR closed unmerged, so automation should not choose the permanent layout direction without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve visible desktop navigation
options.body: Accept a bounded list/sidebar design for desktop and keep the existing dropdown as the mobile fallback.

options.title: Keep dropdown-first design
options.body: Declare the current selector pattern intentional and close the remaining UX half as not planned.

options.title: Fold into broader UI redesign
options.body: Defer this issue to a larger Control UI navigation redesign and link the canonical design item.

recommendation.title: Approve visible desktop navigation
recommendation.body: Accept a bounded list/sidebar design for desktop and keep the existing dropdown as the mobile fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the dashboard-v2 refactor that introduced the affected Agents-page shape and is the clearest feature-history routing signal.
